_readme: The catalogue and the price list.
Three grades, four pack formats. Not every grade ships in every format:
`skus` is the list of combinations actually offered, and it is the list the
price table, the product cards and the quote builder are all built from.
`price_status` has three states and the build behaves differently in each:
placeholder  the figures are invented. Every page carrying a price shows
a pre-launch banner and nothing is quotable.
indicative   the figures are set from published market references, not
from an AragoCor price list. They are real numbers derived
from real observations, recorded under `price_basis` below,
but they are AragoCor's to confirm, so the pages still say
plainly that they are not quotable.
live         the figures are AragoCor's own list. The banner disappears
and the tables carry an effective date. The build refuses
this state while any TODO remains.
To go live: replace `list` on each SKU with the real number, set
`effective_date`, set `price_status` to 'live', and run the build. The
`price_basis` block can then be deleted. Nothing else changes.
Price is always per selling unit: per bag for bagged formats, per bulk bag
for totes, per ton for bulk. Per-pallet, per-pound and per-ton figures are
derived at build time, never stored, so they cannot disagree.

_readme: Where the numbers under `skus` come from. Delete this block when a real
AragoCor price list replaces them.
No supplier of oolitic aragonite publishes bulk or tote pricing; the whole
trade quotes by the load. So only the bagged figures below rest on observed
prices. The tote and bulk figures are derived from the bagged per-pound rate
by the packaging cost that drops out, and are the softest numbers here.
price_basis.method: Observed retail prices, less a channel margin, checked so that the larger pack never costs more per pound than the smaller one.

observed.what: Aragonite soil amendment and feed supplement, 50 lb bag, retail
Dry aragonite aquarium sand, 30 lb bag, retail
observed.note: The low end is the like-for-like comparison: dry, screened, not live-bacteria seeded.

observed.what: Aragonite aquarium sand, 20 lb bag, retail
sources: walmart.com Nature's Ocean Bio-Activ Live 20 lb
observed.note: Live-seeded product and so priced above a dry bag. Used as a ceiling, not a target.

observed.what: Feed grade calcium carbonate, ground limestone, bulk
sources: feedingredientsasia.com feed grade calcium carbonate market 2026
observed.note: The commodity floor. Ground domestic limestone, not marine oolitic aragonite; it sets a lower bound, not a comparison.

margins_applied.bag20: Half of observed dry-aquarium retail. Keystone is the working assumption in the pet channel.
margins_applied.bag50: Two thirds of observed agricultural retail, the usual dealer margin on a bagged input.
margins_applied.tote: About 59% of the 50 lb per-pound rate. Bagging labour, film and the bag itself drop out at 2,000 lb.
margins_applied.bulk: About 70% of the tote per-pound rate. The FIBC itself drops out. Derived, not observed.

price_basis.grade_spread: Medium is the reference. Fine carries about 4% for screening yield, coarse sits about 5% below.

price_note: Prices are FOB Stockton, California and exclude freight. Volume tiers apply across grades and formats on one order.
